problem.summary: Compiled Candidate signals can accumulate point-in-time Forward evidence, but frozen Rule Family v1.3 derives direction from explicit operation actions. Candidate signals may carry source-derived bullish/bearish state semantics without a source-defined buy/sell action.
problem.current_blocker: candidate EventScore and Candidate Family Shadow Scorecards must remain promotion_gate_compatible=false under Evaluation Spec 1.7.

principles: Do not infer buy/sell actions from a signal.
Keep signal direction separate from action direction.
Do not change existing Rule Family v1.3 assignments in place.
A future signal-family definition must create a new immutable family-definition version and a new Evaluation Spec version.
All accumulated Candidate Forward evidence before activation remains archived under the spec/version that governed it and is not silently relabeled.
Promotion thresholds, FDR, MAE noninferiority, author independence, time clustering and symbol concentration must not be relaxed to admit Candidate signals.

direction_semantics.forbidden: automatic conversion to buy/sell/position sizing/order action

proposed_evidence_contract.event_baseline: next trading session open after a completed daily signal state-entry
proposed_evidence_contract.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the full frozen signal-family x horizon hypothesis set
proposed_evidence_contract.mae_noninferiority: same paired cluster-bootstrap contract as Spec 1.7
proposed_evidence_contract.concentration: same maximum single-symbol effective-unit share as Spec 1.7

activation_requirements: No genuine Forward Candidate event has been scored under a contradictory family definition.
Reviewed governance decision explicitly approves Signal Family as a separate promotion unit or explicitly maps it into a new Rule Family definition.
New immutable family definition file and hash.
New Evaluation Spec version; do not edit Spec 1.7 in place.
Evidence lock/update documenting the semantic change.
Regression tests proving historical/backfill sources cannot become Forward evidence.
Regression tests proving signal direction cannot create trading actions.
Re-run statistical controls under the new spec before any Promotion activation.
